territorial_scope.description: Applies within the Yizhuang New City area of the Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area.

evidence.quote: 本措施适用于亦庄新城范围内在同一建设地点总机架数大于50架或总机架功率超过250千瓦的数据中心及所在的园区和企业

summary.short: Management committee measures, effective 2024-03-13, on energy management of data centres in Yizhuang New City (above 50 racks or 250 kW). Links rewards to green power and PUE 1.4, applies differential electricity pricing above the benchmark, caps power use at approved levels, and in principle bars new data centres.
summary.long: Measures issued by the Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area management committee, dated 2024-03-13 and published 2024-04-03, to improve energy and carbon efficiency of data centres in the Yizhuang New City area. They apply to data centres with more than 50 racks or over 250 kW of total rack power, together with their parks and enterprises, including storage, cloud, AI computing, edge and supercomputing facilities. The measures provide for a registry and monitoring through an energy-saving monitoring platform; rewards and recommendations for funding support for data centres that use green electricity, meet a PUE benchmark of 1.4, or convert to intelligent computing centres; public listing of compliant centres; exclusion from infrastructure REITs filings for unauthorised industrial-land use or non-compliant projects; differential electricity pricing for data centres above the benchmark, with the committee determining the subjects; support for relocation to Hebei and Inner Mongolia; a general presumption against new data centres, with economic cooperation agreements for qualifying projects; a cap on electricity use at energy-saving review approvals; and inspections, with penalties under the national energy-saving review measures, publication of results, and reporting to the credit system and joint sanctions for listed seriously dishonest entities.
